decisive_items: episodes of dream enactment became progressively more violent
Violent behaviors were reported every other night
response.rationale: The vignette centers on violent dream enactment in a Parkinson disease patient, classic for RBD. OSA is present but mild (AHI 8.5-12.8) and does not explain the prominent behavioral episodes.

rejected.why: OSA is an incidental polysomnography finding; AHI is only mild and the clinical picture is dominated by dream enactment, which is not typical of OSA.
